svg.title: The misfit map: Quake Locator’s grid search
svg.desc: Map of the RMS misfit for every possible epicenter, light where the circles fit well and dark where they fit badly. A long light valley holds the best fit; the rough-uncertainty contour encloses the points within 1.5 km of the best RMS.
svg.text: The misfit map: Quake Locator’s grid search
Zoom: coarse grid, then finer grids
Real data: M3.3 quake near Junction, Utah, uu80162166; University of Utah analyst picks (network UU) at MTPU, TCRU and WCU.
The RMS of the three residuals at every point, with P 5.8 km/s, S 3.3 km/s, depth 8 km (Quake Locator defaults). Best fit: RMS 0.3 km.
